source_lines_after.60: [L1] $C_m$ carries the triangulated structure inherited from $K(A_m\text{-mod})$, whose distinguished triangles are the cone triangles $X\xrightarrow fY\to\operatorname{Cone}(f)\to X[1]$ and their isomorphic images, with $\operatorname{Cone}(f)^n=Y^n\oplus X^{n+1}$ and $d(y,x)=(d_Yy+fx,-d_Xx)$; the homological shift is $(X[1])^n=X^{n+1}$ with $d_{X[1]}=-d_X$ ([[def-bounded-projective-homotopy-category-for-a-m|The bounded projective homotopy category $C_m$ and the two shifts]], [[thm-the-homotopy-category-of-an-abelian-category-is-triangulated]], [[def-mapping-cone-of-a-chain-map]]).
source_lines_after.66: [F4] The internal shift is defined on graded modules by $(M\{r\})_d=M_{d-r}$, is a degree-zero automorphism of $A_m\text{-mod}$ with $\{r\}\{s\}=\{r+s\}$ and inverse $\{-r\}$; on complexes it acts termwise by $(X\{r\})^n=X^n\{r\}$ with $d_{X\{r\}}=d_X$, and this is an automorphism of $C_m$ preserving the terms' finite graded projectivity ([[def-graded-ring-module-bimodule-and-internal-shift]], [[def-graded-khovanov-seidel-module-category-and-projectives]], [[def-bounded-projective-homotopy-category-for-a-m|The bounded projective homotopy category $C_m$ and the two shifts]]).
